title: wg: room-policy-04 §7 case extension not in PendingProposalStrategy
description: Erratum. L1279 "case extension: ComponentID id_of_strategy_params;" but the enum (L1262-1267) defines only 0-2. One implementation may accept 3-255 with a ComponentID, another reject. mimid treats 3-255 as extension (decision mimid-1wgh.3.22). Fix: define the range.
